text.p: Dutch striker Patrick Kluivert is set to move from Ajax to AC Milan next season.
Kluivert said before training on Thursday that he would be signing a four-year contract with the Italian side.
Kluivert's contract with Ajax expires at the end of this season and the former European champions cannot expect a transfer fee.
Kluivert said last month he was considering offers from several big foreign clubs and wanted to make a fresh start abroad.
He will join his former Ajax team mates and close friends Edgar Davids and Michael Reiziger at Milan.
The Italian club was long rumoured to have had a "first option" on the free-scoring young striker.
